summary: Pin is in bush by the garden road; a small sealed dead-end pad lies nearby.
reasons: Sealed dead-end pad about 40 m south-east

best_section.where: Sealed dead-end pad off the garden road junction, about 40 m south-east of the pin

drivers.seclusion: No buildings or homes within 100 m; pad is ringed by trees and garden, though it is on a visitor road.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin is under canopy with no track; the sealed pad off the 20 km/h garden road is wide enough for a van to pull fully off, with an arch footbridge at its far end.
drivers.traffic: Light garden-road traffic by day; quiet at night.
drivers.convention: No vehicles or campers seen on the pad; it may be a bus or service bay.

flags: Steep at the pin: about 15.7% mean; pad itself not sampled
Mapped gate 274 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Pad is open to sun, with trees shading its north and west edges.
cannot_judge: Whether the pad is a bus or service bay
